# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a section when a frame first wants 4 of its shaders,
# so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README,
# "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section and has
# tools/shader_survey.js start each level through patches/shader_survey.c, the game's own change of state, with the
# player kept alive and firing. Section 0 is the launcher, the logos, the title's opening and the title; then the
# main menu to the Lylat map, each planet from its start for 90 s (all-range) to 150 s (on rails), Meteo's and
# Sector X's warp zones, the training, Venom's two routes and Andross, game over, the Versus menus to a match's start
# and the ending. Not recorded: what a level draws past the time played (most bosses on rails), the other route's
# branches within a level, the Landmaster's and Blue-Marine's end screens, and the rest of a Versus match. Flags follow
# settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again. The menus
# section ends with five that tools/play_plan.json found the recording missed, between the title and Corneria.
